purpose: Search and choose one stable option ID while preserving independent query and selected value state.
behaviorProvider: Installed Base UI Combobox; Aegis useFieldControl and actual nested IconButtons.

component: Pass selected value/defaultValue and query inputValue/defaultInputValue independently to Base UI; selected value is string or null. A typed query is not a free-form submitted selection.

Pass value, input-value, open and open-completion callbacks without dropping primitive details or cancellation. Delegate list navigation, selection, dismissal and focus to Base UI. Cancelling selected-value changes preserves the selected ID; the query remains independent until dismissal requests a label reset through the input-value callback. Keep the derived item collection stable when the supplied options identity is unchanged.

Local matching searches option labels, descriptions and keywords. filterOptions=false delegates the result set to the host. loading announces status and disables current result selection; the component issues no network requests.
Require unique nonempty option IDs. selectedLabel supplies a display fallback when a remote selected ID is absent from the current result list; the underlying selected ID remains unchanged.

Use Field association on the visible input and pass name/form/required/disabled/readOnly to Base UI. Its associated form control submits the selected ID once; the forwarded ref targets the visible input.
host: Own request debouncing, cancellation, races, caching, loading/error recovery and durable selection labels. Keep controlled query and selected value updates separate and inspect callback reasons before issuing requests.

Supply a visible label, enclosing Field label or accessible name. Use useful host validation and recovery instructions instead of relying on placeholder text.

Owned styling consumes input group tokens. Actual nested shared components retain their own token groups. Preserve keyboard-visible focus and equivalent size metrics across the four theme/mode mappings.

limitations: This source-backed requirement record does not certify a current test result or release approval.
Single selection only; use MultiCombobox for multiple values. No free-solo creation or virtualized remote dataset is provided.
No asynchronous fetching, server validation or automatic error recovery. Remote selected labels must remain available through options or selectedLabel.
